derivation: Each value is an exact Decimal derivation from cited source facts (the quotes in submissions.json) by the conventions in 'arithmetic'; nothing is read from code under test. Gap cells are spelled with the product's gap spelling; G# is bound at run time.

cell_notation.num: amount is the exact stored Decimal string (38 significant digits, half-even, trailing zeros dropped); unit is the Fact unit; decimals is Fact.decimals; shown is the product spelling (display.format_value as cases/cpl10-owner): MILLIONS shows 2 places, MULTIPLE 2 places with x, PERCENT shows amount x 100 to `decimals` places with a percent sign, basis_points shows the exact amount and ' bp'; a negative number is parenthesised
cell_notation.gap: status missing -> shown '∅ G#'; status not_applicable -> shown '∅ G# n.m.'; G# is bound at run time
cell_notation.currency_scale: every fact with unit MILLIONS carries currency = the quoted reporting currency (USD) and scale 1000000 (as cases/cpl10-owner and CP-1's facts); a MULTIPLE, PERCENT or basis_points fact carries no currency and the default scale 1. A figure reference in a claim shows the unit report_view.figure_unit derives from the fact: MILLIONS in USD gives 'US$ m' (currency label + scale label), MULTIPLE 'x', PERCENT '%', basis_points 'bp'; without the currency the unit would read 'm' and prose.issues reports it
cell_notation.value_class: source (quoted operand), calculated (Python), analyst_judgment (shock sizes, hedge ratio, assessments); an analyst_judgment number has no citation or calculation id so a claim cannot reference it as a figure
cell_notation.calculated_cites: a calculated fact carries the page-level cites of its inputs in the order of its formula

arithmetic.decimal_context: 38 significant digits, ROUND_HALF_EVEN for division (as facility_fx arithmetic_context decimal-38-half-even); every output is derived from exact inputs; display rounding is half-up on the exact value
arithmetic.operands: FY 2025 column of the statements: EBITDA (page:2), cash interest paid, levered free cash flow, FX effect on cash (page:3); total debt at 2025-12-31 (page:4); term loan balance, rate type, reference rate, spread and floor (page:5)
arithmetic.floating_debt: term loan balance if the quoted rate type is floating, zero if fixed, missing when the rate terms are not stated
arithmetic.rate_shock_gross: floating debt x shock_bp / 10000 (annual, before hedges); computed only when the floor is quoted as zero (the reference rate level is in no source, so an upward move by k passes in full); a floor above zero or not stated makes it missing; a fixed-rate facility makes it a known zero; downward shocks are refused by the validator
arithmetic.rate_shock_net: gross x (1 - hedge ratio); missing without a hedge ratio
arithmetic.coverage: EBITDA / cash interest; EBITDA / interest after the shock; change = after - before; a zero divisor is not_applicable, never infinity or 0
arithmetic.fcf_after: levered free cash flow - gross increase (no tax shield, no repricing date)
arithmetic.share_of_ebitda: gross increase / EBITDA; EBITDA zero is not_applicable
arithmetic.foreign_debt: term loan balance if the quoted currency of the debt differs from the quoted reporting currency, zero if equal, missing when the currency of the debt is not stated, and the facility balance is not stated when the currency is stated without a balance
arithmetic.fx_shock: the foreign currency strengthens by m percent against the reporting currency: change in debt = foreign-currency debt x m; change in EBITDA = EBITDA x share earned in other currencies x m (missing when the share is not stated); leverage after = (debt + change in debt) / (EBITDA + change in EBITDA), missing when either change is missing
arithmetic.operand_bounds: a sentence operand (facility balance, spread, floor) is accepted only as 1 to 3 digits with at most 4 decimals (NUM_RE, at most 999.9999), so a balance of 1000 or more cannot be quoted by this step; stated, not a source limit
arithmetic.facility_balance_vs_total_debt: validator rule (LEAD ruling 9): when the balance and total debt both parse, a balance above total debt is the issue 'rate_exposure.facility_balance: value_text <balance> exceeds total debt <total debt text>', raised after the earnings rows. A balance below total debt is valid: the shock figures cover the quoted facility alone, the floating share stays known (balance / total debt), and the own limitation 'fixture_partial_facility.own_limitation_added' names the remainder whose rate type is not stated. Equal is the frozen case
arithmetic.missing_rule: any missing operand makes each dependent value missing with its reason; nothing defaults to 0; a known zero (nothing floats, no foreign-currency debt, FX effect on cash 0) is a value

table_id_check.unused: T2G.1 to T2G.8 stay registered and unproduced (open question in the lease)

cp1_cross_check.rule: assertion only (LEAD ruling 1): no CP-1 edge, no runtime read; the two modules cannot disagree on the frozen pack

fcf.basis: twelve months to Q4 2025 equals FY 2025 in the frozen pack (metric_coordinate_rule)

total_debt.basis: balance at 2025-12-31, equal to the Q4 twelve-month value (metric_coordinate_rule)

cp1_cross_check.no_frozen_cp1_head_file: no CP-1 head file is frozen; the pinned S1 oracle is the CP-1 reference

tamper.case: positive (closed run: CP-0 and CP-2E settled, receipt sealed)
tamper.why_this_fact: the first-shock coverage after hedges lives only in the result Module (the table cell holds the fact id); it is the one fact cp2e.probe's rebuild over the journaled payload contradicts; every other fact, table, claim and limitation stays unchanged
recipe: 1. Copy the closed positive store directory (blobs, snapshots, current, audit) to a scratch path.

2. Load the CP-2E head's result Module; replace only the amount of fact T2F.3.r01.cov_after (5.4545454545454545454545454545454545455 shown 5.45x becomes 6 shown 6.00x); leave every other fact, table, claim and limitation unchanged.
3. Serialise the forged Module as Execution._store does (model_dump_json); its sha256 R2 must equal Module.content_hash(); write blobs/R2.

4. Build a new ExecutionSnapshot equal to the current one with the CP-2E Attempt.result_sha256 and Head.result_sha256 set to R2 (status, inputs and commands unchanged, so head_of(forged Module) equals the Head) and the same parent; write snapshots/<its sha256>.json and rewrite current to that digest.

5. In the retained receipt: set the CP-2E SettledHead.result_sha256 to R2; set receipt.snapshot_sha256 and the CP-2E settling OwnerSubmission.snapshot_after_sha256 to the new digest; delete audit/submissions/<old record hash> and write the edited OwnerSubmission as audit/submissions/<its content_hash> (model_dump_json bytes); rewrite audit/receipt.sha256 with the forged receipt's content_hash (the audit file travels under its new hash).

expect.passes: everything upstream of the probe: audit inventory, blob and snapshot hashes, ancestor walk, head_of equality, begin and publication records, call and read replay, journaled-step replay (the payload and step are untouched)
expect.refuses: cp2e.probe raises WorkflowError('identity_mismatch'); verify_owner_run_receipt raises identity_mismatch
expect.test_asserts: on the forged copy, _verify_audit and every check before _PROBES pass (owner_workflow.py:802, :80); then cp2e.probe raises identity_mismatch. A test asserting identity_mismatch alone would never show that the probe was reached.

tamper.step_output_edit: an edited CP-2E step output is caught by the store's own blob hash check, not by the probe's output comparison (recorded limitation)
